subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the conflicting fork PR that still closes this issue, or wait for that author to rebase and address the earlier safety concerns?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and still present, but a cross-repository open PR already references it while the original same-repository branch was closed unmerged with proof and safety blockers.

options.title: Adopt or replace the candidate
options.body: Use the fork PR as source context, but land a current-main target-repository fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork PR author to rebase and resolve the earlier mention-gating and root-routing concerns.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as a known Feishu channel bug until a maintainer can prioritize the channel fix.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the candidate
recommendation.body: Use the fork PR as source context, but land a current-main target-repository fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu mention-handling work makes this the closest routing candidate for the safe mention-detection shape.
